author: haydock
title: Catholic Family Bible and Commentary: Genesis
edition: Haydock's Catholic Family Bible and Commentary, New York: Edward Dunigan and Brother, 1859; text from an archive.org transcription of the notes ("Haydock Catholic Bible Commentary", transcriber not named), djvu OCR text

rights.worldwide: public domain: Haydock died in 1849; the 1859 edition's editors and the transcription's maker are still to identify

notes: The notes follow the Douay-Rheims text and its verse numbers. Haydock gathers other Catholic commentators and marks each note with the letter of its source (C. Calmet, Ch. Challoner, M. Menochius, T. Tirinus, W. Worthington, Wi. Witham; H. Haydock himself), and the excerpts keep those letters. One excerpt per verse note ("Ver. 1. ..."), up to about 350 words and cut at a sentence end. The source is the OCR of a typed transcription, not of the 1859 pages; a sentence the OCR damaged is left out and marked " ... ". This transcription is to be checked against a scan of the 1859 edition.
